 This weekend's K-drama lineup features Doctor X: Mafia in White, Final Table, 100 Days of Deception, A Love Other Than Yours, Dive into You and Love on the Menu. We feature the October 31-November 1 release schedule, latest episode dates and streaming platforms, including Netflix, Amazon Prime Video and Viki.  Every hero in this weekend’s K-drama lineup (Oct 31-Nov 1) is up against something bigger than they are. Kim Ji-won’s surgeon takes on a corrupt hospital in Doctor X: Mafia in White, Ahn Hyo Seop’s chef enters a national cooking contest in Final Table, and Kim Yoo-jung’s agent risks everything under colonial rule in 100 Days of Deception. Love on the Menu and Dive into You bring the softer side, with family, first love and a second shot at both, while two series reach their finales. Netflix, Prime Video and Viki have you covered. Here are the 6 Best K-dramas to watch this weekend (Oct 31- Nov 1) including Doctor X: Mafia in White, Final Table, 100 Days of Deception, A Love Other Than Yours, Dive into You and Love on the Menu on Netflix, Prime and more. Check what to expect from these Korean dramas too.
 6 Best K-Dramas To Watch This Weekend (Oct 31-Nov 1)
 Doctor X: Mafia in White, Netflix - Oct 31
 Kim Ji-won returns to the medical thriller genre as Gye Su-jeong, a gifted surgeon who refuses to play by the rules of Guseo University Hospital. Surrounded by professional rivalries, institutional corruption and doctors more concerned with status than patients, she relies on her surgical ability to challenge the establishment. Lee Jung-eun, Son Hyun-joo and Kim Woo-seok also feature. Episode 8 arrives on October 31.
 Final Table, Amazon Prime Video - Oct 31-Nov 1
 Ahn Hyo Seop and Hong Hwa Yeon headline this cooking-themed drama, where the kitchen becomes a competitive arena. Kang Han, an internationally experienced chef, finds himself at Familia, a restaurant struggling after its owner's death and damaged reputation. He teams up with its manager, Choi Song-yi, to represent the restaurant in The Table: K-Chef 2026, a high-stakes competition. Episodes 3 and 4 arrive over the weekend.
 You may also like 5 Upcoming K-Drama OTT Releases In November And December 2026: Remarried Empress, One of a Kind Romance, Gift And More 100 Days of Deception, Netflix - Oct 31-Nov 1
 Kim Yoo Jung and Park Jin-young share the screen in this period spy romance set during the Japanese occupation of Korea. Lee Ga-kyung, a talented pickpocket, becomes an undercover operative for the independence movement and infiltrates the Japanese colonial administration. Her assignment becomes complicated when she develops a connection with an interpreter who has ties to the very establishment she is working against. Episodes 7 and 8 release on October 31 and November 1.
 A Love Other Than Yours, Amazon Prime Video - Oct 31-Nov 1
 What happens when a decade-long relationship no longer feels like a certain path towards marriage? Ahn Eun-jin and Seo Kang-joon play a couple facing that question as new romantic possibilities make them reconsider their future together. Lee Joo Ahn and Jo Aram also star. Episodes 13 and 14 arrive this weekend, with November 1 marking the series finale.
 Dive into You, Viki - Oct 31-Nov 1
 Bona stars as Yoon Ha-na, a popular actress who unexpectedly swaps bodies with her twin brother, a judo champion. An unusual camcorder takes the siblings back in time, giving them a chance to prevent the death of Ha-na's first love, Jung Woo-jae, played by Park Seo-ham. Jang Se-hyuk and Moon Seung-you also feature. Episodes 11 and 12 arrive this weekend, with the latter concluding the series.
 Love on the Menu, Viki - Oct 31-Nov 1
 Ha Seok-jin and Hani lead this family romance about former lovers who find themselves crossing paths again after years apart. He is a wealthy restaurateur, while she works in the world of Korean side dishes, or banchan. Their reunion brings unresolved family conflicts and old feelings back into focus. Episodes 26 and 27 are scheduled for October 31 and November 1.
